lessons.future_rule: After a material dollar-Canada win, three-digit oil plus a rising Canadian impulse is a harvest trigger. Remaining United States rate edge belongs in reduced size, not in a full-size hold that waits to recapture the peak.

lessons.future_rule: The first cut from 8 million to 3 million was not a completed harvest. When three-digit oil and a rising Canadian hike impulse arrive after a paid dollar-Canada win, flatten if you would not initiate from zero; leftover reduced size still waits on peak recapture.
